description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter news app, including app bar, tab navigation, drawer, and various UI components for navigating between different news categories and tool options.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget representing the main home screen with tab navigation for different news categories, app bar actions, drawer, and tool shortcuts.

classes.name: _CategoryTabSpec
classes.description: A helper class to map tab titles to their corresponding widget content.

classes.name: _HomeToolsStrip
classes.description: A widget that displays a horizontal scrollable list of tool buttons for navigation.

classes.name: _HomeDrawer
classes.description: A widget representing the navigation drawer with links to various screens.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including AppBar, TabBar, TabBarView, and other UI components.
